market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: Russell P2 (63 pts) trailing teammate Antonelli (72 pts) by 9 points after Miami sprint. Mercedes dominating 2026; Antonelli on hat-trick of poles. Russell is the established second driver but Antonelli has clear momentum. Two-driver race, Russell ~30%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Antonelli's rookie consistency over the long season
